notes.title: The Open Playtest Starts Today!
notes.content: [p]Today’s the day! [/p][p]The [b]Retro Rewind[/b] open playtest is officially live, and players can finally open shop for the very first time.[/p][p][/p][p]As we mentioned in our [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3552140/view/578271438186743024"]previous post[/url], the main goal of this playtest is to [b]gather your feedback[/b] so we can make the game the best it can be before launch. Was there something unclear while playing? Did you run into anything that felt tedious or unfun? Are there features missing that you’d like to see in the final version? Did you spot a bug, or do you simply want to share something you absolutely loved? We’d love to hear all about it! [/p][p][/p][p]Share your thoughts with us on the [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3552140/discussions/1/?snr=1_2108_9__2107"]Steam Discussion Board[/url] or join the conversation on [url="https://discord.com/invite/cgBqUUhCW3"]Discord[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]Keep in mind, this is our very first playtest and the game is still rough around the edges. We plan to add [b]a lot more content and polish[/b] before the official Steam release. ːBonesawSkellyː[/p][p][/p][p]Have fun, and enjoy your trip down memory lane![/p][p]- The RR Team[/p]

notes.title: Sign Up for the Open Playtest!
notes.content:
[p]We’re excited to announce the very first Retro Rewind open playtest will be available soon! Sign-ups are now open on the game’s [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3552140/Retro_Rewind__Video_Store_Simulator/"]Steam page[/url], and you’ll receive a notification as soon as the playtest begins.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45636661/78d1fe204ef451ccc8e2d17113493ce00968d8dc.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This playtest offers a taste of the full game experience, letting you step into the early 1990s and run your own video rental store for the first 7 in-game days.[/p][p][/p][p]What’s included in the playtest:[/p][list][*][p]Experience a full week as a video store owner in the early 90s.[/p][/*][*][p]Order movies and shelves to start building your business.[/p][/*][*][p]Collect 3 of the 11 available movie genres.[/p][/*][*][p]Play through the full rent/return daily gameplay loop.[/p][/*][*][p]Help customers find the perfect movie based on their requests and preferences.[/p][/*][*][p]Experience the excitement of 1 of many new movie releases.[/p][/*][*][p]Get the slush machine running to serve thirsty customers.[/p][/*][*][p]Use the Design Tool with a limited color set to customize your store’s walls, floor, and ceiling.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Our main goal with this playtest is to gather your feedback. We want to know what you enjoyed, what could use improvement, and what features you’d love to see in the full release. We are still actively working on the game and we want our players to help us make RR the best possible experience. [/p][p][u][b]Share your thoughts with us on the[/b][/u][b] [/b][url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3552140/discussions/1/"]Steam discussion[/url][b] [u]board or in our[/u] [/b][url="https://discord.com/invite/cgBqUUhCW3"]Discord[/url]. We will be reading every comment and suggestion.[/p][p][/p][p]And of course… Don't forget to [u][b]wishlist[/b][/u] the game!
Enjoy the playtest and stay tuned for more updates coming soon![/p][p][/p]
